双臂配对按完整无缺口扫描检出（每臂最多 3 个替换，正向转录本）；非允许转录本上: An exhaustive ungapped scan finds paired-arm matches (up to 3 substitutions per arm on forward transcripts). Exact pairs on disallowed transcripts are excluded; near-match evidence is kept for review.
插入缺失未复核；候选保留不代表已经通过实验特异性验证。: Insertions and deletions are not assessed; retention does not establish experimental specificity.
先检查编号、桥接探针和参考序列: Check transcript IDs, bridge probes and reference sequences first
任务已通过输入检查。下面的设置将用于本次计算。: Input checks passed. These settings will be used for computation.
不足时保留实际数量；CSV 第 4 列优先: Keep the available number if fewer; CSV column 4 takes precedence
同一对 L/R 两臂间隔固定为 0 nt: The L/R gap within each pair is fixed at 0 nt
物种模式：同物种其他转录本只参与排序: Species mode: other same-species transcripts affect ranking only
严格模式：目标之外的完全配对一律排除: Strict mode: exclude exact pairs outside the target
亚基因组模式：只允许目标所属亚基因组: Subgenome mode: allow only the target subgenome
勾选“是否考虑多套染色体”后，自动使用参考库已保存的归属并启用亚基因组模式；允许: Enabling multiple chromosome sets uses saved reference assignments and activates subgenome mode. Allowed transcript IDs are treated as extra allowed targets. Otherwise the selected policy applies
非允许配对排除阈值（每臂最多错配）: Disallowed-pair exclusion threshold (maximum mismatches per arm)
0 表示只排除完全配对；提高后带错配的近似配对也会排除。阈值未经实验校准: 0 excludes exact pairs only; higher values also exclude near matches. This threshold has not been experimentally calibrated
臂长、Tm、GC 与序列复杂度: Arm length, Tm, GC and sequence complexity
双臂配对使用完整无缺口扫描，在每臂最多 3 个替换、正向转录本的范围内找全；不包:
An exhaustive ungapped paired-arm scan covers up to 3 substitutions per arm on forward transcripts; insertions and deletions are not assessed. Results are candidates for review, not a finalized synthesis list.
After submission, the job enters the background queue. You can close this page and return to Job history for progress and results.
从 FASTA 标题提取序列编号，生成“编号 → 亚基因组”的两列 CSV，上传: Extract sequence IDs from FASTA headers and generate a two-column ID-to-subgenome CSV. Save it in the reference library to enable it during split-probe design.
每个文件指定一个亚基因组，默认名称取自文件名。所有文件的编号会合并到同一个 CS: Assign a subgenome to each file; the filename is used by default. IDs are combined in one CSV, and multiple files may share a subgenome.
特征规则：X / x 代表一位数字: Feature rules: X / x matches one digit
原文匹配：所有字符均按原样匹配: Literal matching: match every character as written
例如 A0X → A、B0X → B；Axx 可匹配 A01、A12。BjuVA: For example, A0X → A and B0X → B; Axx matches A01 or A12. BjuVA06G01970 contains A0X and is assigned to A. Rules match only the first ID in a header, not descriptions or sequence contents.
支持 .fa、.fasta、.fna 及其 gzip 文件；文件处理后不保存在上: Supports .fa, .fasta, .fna and gzip files. Processed files are not saved to the upload library.
我确认仅导出已匹配的编号，未匹配编号不写入归属 CSV。: I confirm that only matched IDs will be exported; unmatched IDs will be excluded from the assignment CSV.
表格各预览前 100 条；下载包含全部记录。相同编号按大小写不敏感合并。一个编号: Tables preview the first 100 records; downloads include all records. IDs are merged case-insensitively. Resolve IDs assigned to multiple subgenomes before exporting; rule order does not resolve conflicts. Assignments depend on your ID features, so verify them before design.
L/M/R 三段组合靶向同一转录本。单条按基因编号或序列设计，批量按 CSV 逐: L/M/R segments target the same transcript. Design a single task by gene ID or sequence, or a CSV batch, and download a result ZIP when complete.
三探针仍使用单臂 BLAST 的旧判定，尚未迁移到双探针的双臂配对扫描。结果请按: Triplet probes still use legacy single-arm BLAST assessment and have not migrated to paired-arm scanning. Treat results as candidates.
每行一个任务，没有表头：任务名称、桥接探针编号、基因编号，可选第 4 列为该任务: One task per row, without a header: task name, bridge probe ID, gene ID, and an optional fourth column for the selection limit.
基因编号依次在别名表、内置 TAIR CDS、TAIR cDNA 和所选参考库中: Gene IDs are searched in the alias table, built-in TAIR CDS, TAIR cDNA and selected reference, in that order.
找不到序列或编号无效的行会跳过，并列在结果 ZIP 的: Rows with missing sequences or invalid IDs are skipped and listed in the result ZIP's
结果文件和探针编号使用任务名称。: Task names are used in result filenames and probe IDs.
用于 BLAST 检查探针在其他序列上的结合；不选则跳过特异性检查。: Used by BLAST to check probe binding to other sequences. Leave empty to skip specificity assessment.
